fail_closed_rules: Sold Prior and Sold Post without consideration are not assigned prices.
Withdrawn Post is not represented as a completed sale or current availability.
Unreadable official update endpoints are not reconstructed or guessed.
Historical AST, lease and licence periods are not silently extended to current occupation.
Future CPI, RPI and open-market reviews are not treated as current rent.
Seller or management fees are kept separate from tenant-paid occupational rent.
Peppercorn and nominal head rents are not represented as occupational income.
Vacant possession is not represented as income-producing occupation.
Planning consent, prior approval and development potential are not represented as implemented or valued outcomes.
Tenant options and post-expiry occupation are not inferred.
Administration status prevents historical headline rent from being treated as current collectible income.
Active registry status does not imply covenant strength or property-level performance.
